pages.scan: Opened works/auto-6294ee8a2094/workflow/review/page-08.png with Read and looked at the lettered art. The page has six panels. Panel A, top left: caption 'Meanwhile, the pharmacy is notified and fills the prescription.' and a teal label 'NEW PRESCRIPTION' above a tablet with a pill icon. A moustached pharmacist in a white coat puts medicine into a paper bag. Panel B, top right: caption 'The lab is notified.' and a teal label 'LAB ORDER: samples to collect' over the top of a monitor. A lab tech with glasses, a bun and purple gloves holds up a sample tube beside a tube rack. Panel C, full-width middle tier: caption 'Later that day, Ravi gives his samples at the clinic lab.' Ravi sits in a blood-draw chair pressing cotton to his arm. The lab tech holds a tube. 'All done, Ravi! We'll let you know when your results are ready.' has a tail to her. Panel D, bottom left and tall: caption 'Results ready: Ravi is notified.' and a teal label 'Welbuk Health app · email · WhatsApp'. Ravi, at home on a sofa at dusk, holds up a phone with a check mark. Panel E, bottom right upper: caption 'Dr. Ananya is notified on Welbuk Care.' and a teal label 'RESULTS READY'. The doctor looks at a tablet showing a tube and a check mark. Panel F, bottom right lower: caption 'The clinic is notified on Welbuk Practice.' and a teal label 'RESULTS READY' on a monitor. The receptionist at her desk smiles at the screen with a check mark. Reading order: A, B, C (caption, lab tech), D, E, F.
pages.observation: The order is clear: the tall left panel, then the right column top to bottom. The tail in Panel C is correct, and Ravi's silent smile is his response. Nothing has shown the doctor writing a prescription, so 'Meanwhile' and 'the prescription' rely on the PLAN OF CARE label on page 06. Ravi never collects the medicine. The page 07 to page 08 sequence reads as Ravi leaving and then returning to the clinic lab later. The labels sit over the tablet, the monitor top and the screens, and cover no faces or hands. The Panel B label partly hides the top of the monitor. The captions in Panels A and B touch the top borders. All text is readable.
